text: Hazards come in three kinds. Biological: germs like Salmonella and cholera, and aflatoxin, a poison made by a mould on damp maize and groundnut. Chemical: pesticide residues, heavy metals, adulterants. Physical: glass, stones, hair. Safety is protected by hygiene, dry storage, pasteurisation and refrigeration, the HACCP system of watching every critical step, and the law: in Nepal, the Food Act, the Department of Food Technology and Quality Control, and the Right to Food Act of twenty seventy five.
